source_region: Object-local AABB of all cached multiview/failed-skin projected site pools, padded8mm per component; inferred union of possible grip region, not per-finger observed contacts or a measured uncertainty interval; raw distant source excluded by retained source evidence
patch_rule: Clip unchanged native convex object faces to source region; subtract interiors of other native hulls; group exterior surface by dominant signed native object axis
pair_rule: Opposite signed axis patches; use potential dim3 samples with exact saved friction and both saved wrenches; no actual contact or motor claim
assignment: Within each mode choose feasible pair by lowest worst-load potential total normal force, then current actual URDF tip-to-patch geometry; no source-pose winner
root_anchor: unchanged wristv3 frame50; not source-pose or MCP failed centers
next_geometry_method: One bounded dynamic surface-correspondence solve per declared contact mode; no fixed robot triangle and no forced missing middle contact. Native actual contacts, required wrench, .76Nm cap, source and1mm checks decide rejection.
new_geometry_contract: Use compiled native graph support vertices, not hull of all raw vertices. Native model and all gates unchanged.
